title: The Only Venomous Primate Makes Its Venom in Its Elbows

scenes.text: This cute animal has venom in its elbows.
It's the slow loris, the only venomous primate.
Glands on the inside of its elbows make the toxin.
When threatened, it licks the elbow, mixing the toxin with saliva. Then its bite can send a victim into shock.
Mothers even lick it onto their babies' fur to keep predators away.
Cute on the outside. Venom in the elbows.

description:
This cute animal has venom in its elbows.
The slow loris mixes the toxin from its elbow glands with saliva to make a venomous bite.
Would you have guessed?
first_comment: Cute but venomous. What is the most surprising animal you know that looks harmless?
